E1 booth staff signs in directly and lands in their booth workspace
E2 attendee QR captured: a lead for the correct booth and ticket exists in PostgreSQL
E3 qualification (HOT, tag, private note) saved; a re-scan with only the badge preserves it
E4 a ticket from another congress is refused (400) and creates no lead
E5 lead search finds the lead; the CSV matches the backend record exactly
E6 a lead scan whose response is lost: no success shown, exactly one lead exists, a second scan only updates it
E7 the other booth's staff cannot read, scan, update or export these leads (403) and a switched account sees none
F1 reservations and issued tickets: tiers show reserved 3 of 3 and match PostgreSQL
F2 analytics equal the real admissions (tickets, unique admitted, scans) and match PostgreSQL
F3 event CSV export matches the check-in records (whole event) and contains no Beta data
F4 switching to Beta shows only Beta numbers; Alpha data never leaks; Beta analytics are zero scans
F5 the other tenant's organizer cannot see any of this event's reports
F6 no request in the whole journey mixed credential families (organizer key only on organizer routes; desk token only on its event)

exceptions: Organizer + second tenant provisioning (POST /api/organizers with the platform admin token; no UI)
Registration of two booth representatives, one unrelated User and a second-congress attendee (POST /api/auth/register; the representatives must exist before the Booths tab can authorize them)
Scanner device token issuance and revocation (POST /api/checkin-points/{id}/token and /devices/{id}/revoke; no Organizer UI for scanner devices exists)
Camera decoding: a physical camera / keyboard-wedge reader is not available; codes are typed into the supported manual-entry fields
